text:
maya: Heads up — I noticed a throughput regression on Private VPC prefill path after yesterday's kernel-selector change. P50 went up ~18%. attaching quick trace.
rahul: Ugh. Which change? selector fallback order or the new small-gpu heuristic?
lena: Did you see KV cache eviction spikes? On constrained nodes small prefill budgets can cause more KV churn and kernel switches.
maya: attaching profiler snippet. main weirdness is increased kernel churn during prefill -> many short batches instead of one mid-size batch.
maya: ```
# snippet from perf dump
prefill_tokens=32
batch_target=64
kernel_plan: [attn_fast, attn_fallback, attn_fast]
kv_evictions: 48/min
```
dmitri: That kernel_plan alternating is the problem — kernel selector is oscillating when seq_len is near threshold. Selector keeps trying fast kernel, seeing slowdown due to memcpy on small GPU buffers, then falls back, then tries again.
rahul: On VPC we hit lower PCIe bandwidth and smaller slice sizes — we should allow a slightly higher prefill token budget so batches form larger before kernel decision kicks in.
lena: Agree. We can add a private/vpc override: increase continuous_batching.prefill_budget and relax fast-kernel aggressiveness on private deployments.
maya: Proposed config patch:
```json
"continuous_batching": {
  "prefill_budget_tokens": 48,
  "batch_target_tokens": 80,
  "kernel_aggressiveness": "low"
}
```
rahul: Can we scope it to node labels? e.g., private.smallgpu.* only. Don't want hosted to change.
dmitri: Yep — config supports routing overrides. Also add a short-term emergency opt: disable fast kernel probe for that node class to stop oscillation.
perf-bot: perf/regression alert created: REG-2024-1947 linking traces and flamegraphs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot pushed canary config to vpc-us-east-2-smallgpu at tag "canary/vpc-prefill-2024-10-01" :rocket:
maya: After canary, P50 dropped back ~10% vs current, KV evictions down ~60%. Looks promising.
lena: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) add unit test for kernel selector hysteresis near threshold, (2) continue profing for memcpy hotspots, (3) roll default override to reserved VPCs only.
rahul: I'll open a PR with the config and tests. assign to dmitri for review.
dmitri: Reviewing today. If green, schedule canary-to-prod tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks all. tagging @oncall in case there's fallout during rollout.
